title: Quote Forms
seo: Quote request form setup for services
meta: Short quote forms that ask for what you need to reply well and send leads to your inbox. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Quote forms that collect what you need to reply well
overview: A long form scares people off, and a short one leaves you guessing. We design a quote form with only the questions you need to price the job, such as service type, size, place and timing. It has clear labels, mobile-friendly fields and a friendly confirmation. We route each request to your inbox or CRM, send the sender an automatic receipt, and test it with sample enquiries before launch.

faq: Which tools can you build the form in?
Your site's own form tool, Typeform, Jotform, Google Forms, Gravity Forms, Wix Forms and similar. We pick the one that fits your site and budget, and you own the account.
How do I know which questions to ask?
We start from how you price work and what slows your replies. Then we cut every question that does not change your answer, so people finish the form.
Can the form send leads to my CRM?
Yes, for common tools such as HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho and Google Sheets. Tell us your tool in the order form, and we confirm it before we start.
How do you keep spam out?
We add hidden checks and a simple verification step that does not annoy real people. We do not use methods that collect extra personal data from visitors.
